about: Fast edit manifest: the worker runs setup and build; one Claude call writes the plan files. See services/worker/fast_edit.py.

plan.doc: the whole edit for scripts/build_glass.py (schema in its docstring, below): caption groups as word-index ranges covering every word, cards, kinetic beats, zooms, optional music. Follow references/design-system.md for density, placement and timing; time every card and beat to word onsets from the transcript

sfx.doc: sound plan for scripts/build_sfx.py (its docstring): one subtle cue on each card/beat entrance; a resource sound may be named by its path
